source_title: GAIL Q2 net profit jumps to ₹4,650 cr as gas marketing revenue rises
source_excerpt:
GAIL's September-quarter profit more than doubled to ₹4,650 crore as gas marketing revenue rose 31%. The company also approved plans to list subsidiary GAIL Gas through an IPO.
GAIL's net profit more than doubled to ₹4,650 crore in the September quarter, driven by strong gas marketing growth. The company also approved plans for a potential IPO of subsidiary GAIL Gas.
